'''Stumble''' was a [[Ta-Ree]] spell capable of being wielded by [[Ascendant (Kathol)|Ascendants]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. The spell allowed the caster to cause another individual to misperceive the location of obstacles in their path, causing them to lose their balance and fall over.

Ascendants who wished to cast the spell were required to know the [[psychokinesis]] spell.
